Bot fight autopsy

Measured from per-decision native traces of the same nine games that were recorded as videos. CauseOfDeath is the sim enum. Arrow spawns are live kind=0/layer=9 entities. Line-of-sight is a 24-sample ray against the rounded-rect walls (centers updated each frame). Sudden death in Bopl starts at 120s of level time and sinks platforms via AnimateVelocity. Research telemetry at env end only covers the last step, so ability counts below come from the bot log and arrow entities, not telemetry.
